plugins.name: litigation-legal
plugins.description: Litigation and legal-research workflows powered by legal MCP servers (CourtListener, Descrybe, Trellis, Courtroom5, Legal Data Hunter): grounded case-law research, citation/quote verification, docket monitoring, judge analytics, and deadline calculation. Every legal claim is tied to a verifiable primary source; output is research support, not legal advice.
